caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object consisting of a metal base with ornate, swirling patterns and four corner posts. Resting on this base is a figure of a person dressed in a red shirt, gray pants, and a hat with red and gray coloring. The figure is posed standing on one leg, with the other leg bent and resting on a round, red ball. The person’s right arm is raised while the left hand is placed on their hip. The base appears metallic with a bronze or brass coloration and includes additional decorative elements, such as a face on one of its sides. The overall composition centers the figure atop the ball and ornate base, rendered against a plain, light beige background. In the bottom left corner of the image, there is a signature reading “Leo Tauer.”
title: Metal Toy Bank: Boy on Bar
